entries.title: The Oculus
body: A tower of floating rings above the Nexus. Malygos uses the Arcanomicon to find the ley lines and tap them, diverting the magic that runs beneath the earth to the Nexus. Here the stolen energies are focused through the ascending rings and blasted into the Twisting Nether.
The Kirin Tor have allied with the red dragonflight against him. Together they are undermining his offensive, but time is running out.

entries.title: The Band of Variance
body: The lowest ring of the Oculus, where the dragonspawn Drakos holds captive three dragons of other flights, one red, one green, one bronze.

entries.title: The Upper Rings
body: The Bands of Acceleration, Transmutation and Alignment, rising one above another, each a stage in turning the world's magic towards the Nether. Only on dragonback can they be reached.

entries.title: Drakos the Interrogator
body: A blue dragonspawn who interrogates the captives of the Oculus.

entries.title: Varos Cloudstrider
body: One of the azure-lords of the blue dragonflight, and captain of its forces in the Oculus.

entries.title: Mage-Lord Urom
body: A mage of the Kirin Tor who went over to Malygos.

entries.title: Ley-Guardian Eregos
body: The blue dragon who commands the Oculus and the whole work of turning the ley lines.
